cookiecutter.package_title: API Wrapper to Binance Cryptocurrency Exchange
cookiecutter.description: R API wrapper to the Binance cryptocurrency exchange supporting both synchronous and asynchronous (promise based) operations. Provides R6 classes for spot market data, trading (including OCO orders), account management, deposits, withdrawals, internal transfers, margin trading, margin data, sub-accounts, Simple Earn, and USD-M futures (market data and trading). Includes bulk kline backfill with CSV resume support, live event-driven WebSocket market-data streams (order book depth), and timestamp conversion utilities.
